user_outcome: Maintain the fixed-five expectation map / 核对并维护五案例期望地图

preconditions.description: Work from the actual OSStack checkout root with supported Node (this recipe uses Node 22), repository pnpm, installed dependencies, local Git and current compiled artifacts. Retain install/build logs; a successful build is not product verification.

Set an explicit absolute owned OSSTACK_SCRATCH_ROOT, create its runtime parent and a fresh feature_root as described in README.md. Do not use a repository, bare volume root or serving home. The output directory must not exist; its parent must exist.

Copy docs/implementation/skills-check-map-maintenance/map.json or the specified absolute SOURCE_MAP into feature_root/map.json and preserve map-original.json. Input must be a regular non-symlink UTF-8 JSON file, at most 64 KiB, with exactly the fixed five distinct IDs.

drive_refs: Prepare an owned map copy and preserve the original, using README.md and docs/verification/method-control-tutorial.md.
Run compare-map once with stdout/stderr and exit code retained as sibling files. This entry accepts only --map and --output; runJourney internally performs doctor then drive for all five cases.
Read maintenance.json if output was acquired, then journey/journey.json, journey-manifest.json and every case manifest/cleanup/raw command record.

observations.observable: Exit 0 / consistent requires five verified observations matching the map, unchanged map bytes and complete retained evidence. Exit 1 / mismatch means a legal map disagrees with a verified journey; it does not classify the cause. Exit 2 / blocked covers input/refusal, prerequisites, execution, evidence or map changes.
side_effects: Creates one new owned maintenance output and isolated local Git fixtures; executes compiled skills check. Does not edit the input map, product or previous evidence.

observations.observable: Expected verified product exits/statuses are healthy 0/healthy, missing-ref 1/failed, drift 2/drift, mixed 1/failed and empty 0/empty. Driver exit 0 verifies the negative predicate; it does not repair a failed/drifted source. Empty means zero sources, not healthy sources.

Inspect status, execution_path, map.unchanged, all rows.matches, journey overall status, verification/driver_exit, manifest hashes and cleanup. Cleanup passed/fixture_removed true requires the recorded fixture path absent while evidence remains readable; descendant termination remains not_attested.
side_effects: Disposes only owned fixtures; retains successful and failed output records.

gotchas: README.md gives shell preparation and variable meanings; do not execute command strings merely because the selector returns them.

source_revision binds one named source file and driver_version binds one named entry script by current SHA-256. These local pins do not cover every helper, dependency or compiled file; they are not build provenance.
Material selection and caller-reported bindings do not drive the product, resolve evidence authority or establish runtime coverage.
A malformed map is refused before output creation; sibling stdout/stderr/exit files are the record. Missing maintenance.json on this path is expected.
The map is a closed five-row expectation format, not this feature selector index. Missing, duplicate or extra case IDs cannot be silently omitted.
A mismatch is not proof of a product regression or documentation drift. Do not lower expected behavior to make a broken product agree.
recovery_refs: Preserve stderr, stdout, exit status, map-original.json and every failed output. On map rejection, compare its exact error to the documented closed contract before editing only the authorized copy.

For an evidenced map-only correction, keep the earlier snapshot and use the same compare-map entry with a fresh output such as maintenance-02. Do not overwrite maintenance-01 or original source input.

For an environment, tool or product failure, diagnose the actual cause within the authorized scope. If cleanup is unknown, retain residue and report it; do not delete unrelated paths or keep blindly repeating.
known_gaps: No new live evidence is attached; covered_entry_ids is empty and all entries remain unverified. Historical runs are not relabeled as this candidate.
Only local CLI routes are described; no UI/RPC, remote installation, host/model execution or complete A35/A48 qualification.
Maintenance owner is unassigned until project configuration names one. No health service, periodic scheduler, notification or automatic repair is configured.
Single-file source/driver pins do not attest transitive helpers, dependencies or compiled artifacts. Use retained run bindings when executing a separately authorized journey.
This fixed comparison does not perform general source review, discover unmapped features or classify A45 tool/map/product fault causes. W19 owns that broader maintenance closure.
